title: Pinned Firecracker/jailer process specification and binary provenance gate
commit_message: feat(isolation): pin Firecracker and validate jailer launch

deliverables.binary_manifest: BinaryManifest{name,version,sha256,machine}; validated at construction (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version, 64-hex sha256 normalized lowercase, safe name); is_pinned() == (version == PINNED_VERSION v1.16.1)
deliverables.pinned_manifests: pinned_firecracker(machine)/pinned_jailer(machine) for x86_64 and aarch64 with official v1.16.1 SHA-256
deliverables.binary_verifier: BinaryVerifier::verify_bytes/verify_path: (1) manifest pinned, (2) exact SHA-256 match, (3) ELF release/static form, (4) embedded version string; all failures => ErrorCode::BinaryProvenanceError before spawn
deliverables.elf_form_check: parse_elf_form: ELF64 little-endian, e_type ET_EXEC or ET_DYN (PIE), e_machine match, statically_linked = no PT_INTERP, has_debug_sections = any .debug_* section. require_release_static rejects dynamic/GNU (PT_INTERP), debug (.debug_*), and machine mismatch
deliverables.jailer_argv: JailerArgv::builder(...).build(): always --cgroup-version=2 + pre-created --parent-cgroup; requires --netns, non-root --uid/--gid, >=1 bounded --resource-limit (fsize/no-file in [1,max]); invalid => ErrorCode::InvalidResourceSpec before spawn; deterministic argv (BTreeMap-sorted resource limits)
deliverables.resource_limits: ResourceKind{Fsize,NoFile} (the two jailer v1.16.1 resources); MAX_FSIZE_BYTES=1TiB, MAX_NO_FILE=1<<20; recommended defaults fsize=250000000, no-file=1024
deliverables.seccomp_stub: parse_seccomp_mode/verify_seccomp_status/SeccompVerifier: post-exec /proc/<pid>/status must report Seccomp:2 (filter). Documented that the jailer does NOT install seccomp; Firecracker installs it after exec. Missing/non-filter => ErrorCode::ProcessSpawnError
deliverables.helpers: sha256_hex (sha2 crate), binary_contains_version (strips leading v; release embeds 1.16.1)

pinned_binaries.source: official release tarballs; SHA-256 verified against the SHA256SUMS shipped inside each tarball
pinned_binaries.elf_form_observed: x86_64 release is ET_DYN (PIE), aarch64 release is ET_EXEC; both static (0 PT_INTERP) with 0 .debug_* sections; release keeps .symtab

privileged_test.happy_path: verified the genuine v1.16.1 x86_64 firecracker (sha256 2fd017...) and jailer (sha256 1f3a0c...) against the pinned manifests via MICROVM_PINNED_FIRECRACKER/MICROVM_PINNED_JAILER overrides
privileged_test.blocked_path: without pinned binaries on PATH, reports blocked: firecracker_binary_missing / jailer_binary_missing / no_pinned_binary_verified and still passes (platform pass/blocked/failed model)

test_coverage.manifest_validation: valid record accepted; bad sha256/version/empty name rejected with BinaryProvenanceError; sha256 normalized to lowercase
test_coverage.argv_generation: required flags present (--cgroup-version=2, --parent-cgroup <leaf>, --netns, non-root --uid/--gid, bounded fsize=/no-file=); deterministic; root uid/gid, missing fields, empty id, unbounded/zero/absent resource limits rejected with InvalidResourceSpec
test_coverage.hash_verification_logic: sha256 known vectors (empty, abc); matching static release accepted; hash mismatch rejected (stage=hash_mismatch); tampered file rejected; missing file rejected (stage=io)
test_coverage.rejection_of_debug_binaries: debug build (.debug_info) rejected even with matching hash (stage=debug_build); GNU/dynamic (PT_INTERP) rejected even with matching hash (stage=dynamic_binary); machine mismatch rejected; non-pinned manifest rejected (stage=not_pinned); missing embedded version rejected (stage=version_mismatch)
test_coverage.elf_form: static release accepted; PIE/static accepted; PT_INTERP detected; .debug_* detected; non-ELF/truncated/wrong-class/wrong-endianness/non-executable rejected
test_coverage.seccomp: parse Seccomp:2/0/absent; verify requires filter mode (ProcessSpawnError otherwise); configurable proc root; missing pid status => ProcessSpawnError
test_coverage.no_child_process: the module exposes no spawn API and constructs no std::process::Command; every rejection is pre-spawn (asserted in privileged provenance_rejects_debug_and_wrong_hash_without_spawning)

guardrails.error_contract: BinaryProvenanceError for binary provenance (pre-spawn); InvalidResourceSpec for argv configuration (pre-spawn); ProcessSpawnError for post-exec seccomp state

design_notes.determinism: manifest validation, sha256, ELF parsing, version scan, argv generation, and seccomp-status parsing are pure; verify_path/SeccompVerifier take configurable roots and are tested against synthetic/tempdir inputs in the default run
design_notes.version_scan: release binaries embed the numeric 1.16.1 (no v prefix); binary_contains_version strips a leading v before scanning, so it accepts the genuine artifact
design_notes.pie_handling: e_type accepts both ET_EXEC (aarch64) and ET_DYN PIE (x86_64) because the official releases differ
design_notes.symtab_note: the stripped release retains .symtab, so .symtab is deliberately NOT treated as a debug signal; only .debug_* sections indicate a debug build
